diffs.diff: minimum supply: part 4.75 V, datasheet reading 5 V
diffs.evidence: Seeed gives only a nominal rail ('Operating Voltage 5.0V(DC)') with no tolerance, and the 5 V-powered NE555 oscillator accepts 'Input supply voltage, 4.5V to 16V', so the model's 4.75 V minimum is just the usual -5% tolerance of that nominal 5 V supply and still above the NE555's 4.5 V floor, not a different value.

diffs.diff: maximum supply: part 5.25 V, datasheet reading 5 V
diffs.evidence: Seeed gives only a nominal rail ('Operating Voltage 5.0V(DC)'), and the NE555 on that rail is rated 'Input supply voltage, 4.5V to 16V', so the model's 5.25 V maximum is the usual +5% tolerance of the nominal 5 V supply and stays far below the chip limit.
